narrative.details:
I'm sorry I can't be of much help, adventurer, but I can refer you to someone who would be. Caz Twosprocket, one of our best blacksmiths, works the forge at the smithy.

Take the shield to him, and see what he can tell you.
narrative.objectives: Show the Blackened Iron Shield to Caz Twosprocket in Theramore.
narrative.offerRewardText: Hm... interesting piece of iron you have here. Definitely not made by any of the blacksmiths I know over on this side of the sea, and it's certainly not my work.
narrative.requestItemsText: Something for me to look at?
